scripts.deploy: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), b = process.env.R2_BUCKET; if (b) fs.writeFileSync('wrangler.deploy.jsonc', fs.readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc', 'utf8').replaceAll('replace-with-r2-bucket', b)); else throw new Error('R2_BUCKET 환경변수가 비어 있음')" && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
